findings: DEFECT 1: anesthesiaEngine.ts omitted takesBetaBlockers, hasHypertension, hasCardiacArrhythmia, hasIschemicHeartDisease, hasMyocardialInfarctionHistory from input and cardio risk evaluation. FIXED: fully integrated into AnesthesiaCalculationInput and cardioRisk evaluation.
DEFECT 2: anesthesiaEngine.ts omitted diastolic hypertension (bpDiastolic >= 90 mmHg) from cardiovascular risk gating. FIXED: diastolic threshold added to both engines.

DEFECT 3: In AnesthesiaQuickBar, if a doctor selects articaine 1:100 000 with a cardio-risk patient, there was NO visible warning badge indicating 1:100 000 epinephrine risk or recommending Mepivacaine 3% without vasoconstrictor. FIXED: added prominent cardio warning badge with 1-click drug switch.

DEFECT 4: UI dosage display in AnesthesiaQuickBar used acronym 'МРД' instead of human-readable clinical Russian and did not display clear remaining dose balance. FIXED: added formatAnesthesiaRemainingDoseRu with real-time balance tracking.
DEFECT 5: remainingSafeCarpulesCount was missing from AnesthesiaCalculationResult in anesthesiaEngine.ts. FIXED: added to calculation result.
DEFECT 6: Bupivacaine 0.5% in anesthesiaEngine.ts lacked strict pediatric check (<12 years old) and arrhythmia contraindication. FIXED: pediatric check and arrhythmia blocks added.

DEFECT 7: generateAnesthesiaDiaryEntry lacked inclusion of doctor autonomy override reasons (Mandate 8e, Art. 70 323-FZ) when doses/risks are overridden. FIXED: legal autonomy disclaimer added when doctor overrides safety warnings.
